$comment: Sequences of writes replayed through Engine/TextRouter (RoutingCorpusChecks). A step sets the frame `f` and the time `t` (seconds), then one of: `write` (the game sets the text), `append` (the game reads what the component holds — our output in its shown form — and writes it back with more), `refresh` (what the component holds is set again, as the scanner's sweep does), `tick` (the stabiliser runs), `arrive` (a translation comes back for `o`). `shows` is what a person reads on the component after the step (the logical text behind a presented form). `queued` is everything sent for translation, in order. `present: rtl` presents right-to-left text as the flagged branch of RtlPresenter does. `file` holds source → translation, numbers written as [!v*N] where the file would. See analyse/banc-routage-texte.md (root).

cases.why: the ordinary case: nothing held, nothing queued
a text may still be growing; it is sent only once nothing has moved for the stabiliser's delay
replaced within half a second, nobody read it — and a template expanded in place looks exactly like this
no fragment of a reveal is ever sent: the finished line is known, and the reveal is told the moment it is recognised
a reveal that moves a colour tag along a finished sentence says the same thing every frame: one request, not one per frame (one sentence once cost 93)
no spaces to cut on: the same reveal rules hold for a language written without them
a tooltip built in parts: each part is a line of the file, the whole is not
procedural objects: the part the file lacks is sent alone, and its answer goes back into the tooltip still on screen
a book written sentence by sentence onto the component: the whole page when the file has it, the new sentence alone otherwise, a late answer put back into the page

cases.why: the page moved on before the answer came back: rebuilding the old one over the new would erase what the game shows
🔴 a page only APPENDED to keeps its parts when the game replaces it (nothing resets them there): the parts must belong to what is on screen before anything is rebuilt
the game rewrites a whole page the file lacks and appends to it before the answer: each late answer is put back into the page, and the last one leaves no source text on it (2026-09-26, option A)

cases.why: 🔴 the game builds a page onto our shaped text, then redraws it whole in English and appends to THAT: every piece is in the file, so nothing may show in English or be sent (capture of a book, 2026-09-26: 5.5 s of English)
a part opening with a Windows paragraph break ('\r\n\r\n'): found bare in the file, its translation must not glue the two paragraphs together; found with its break, it keeps its own

🔴 a game that wraps its own lines (a TextMesh cannot) rebuilds the text it holds word by word in the same frame: holding our translation, it lays out the translation with its own measure — every step is left exactly as it wrote it, nothing is translated or sent word by word

🔴 the text the game lays out is not in the file: it is sent as ONE line, never word by word (135 of 171 answers in one capture were single words), and the game's layout of it and its redraws are left as they are

cases.why: 🔴 at its next showing the game writes back the translation it read from the component, whole, in a new frame, and lays it out again: that whole is answered early as ours, and the pass on it must still be followed — the words of our own translation were sent to the model one by one (2026-09-26)

a text short enough for one line comes out of the pass exactly as it went in: it must not be remembered as the game's layout, or it would stay in the source language at every later showing. Its one line IS the width the game kept: a longer translation arriving late is wrapped to it (on one line it ran out of the bubble, 2026-09-26); at the next showing the game lays the translation out itself

🔴 the scene sweep reads the game's layout back and asks the lookup directly: taken for a new line, it replaced the whole the reveal was holding (dropped, never sent) and went to the model with the game's line breaks in it, a key no later showing matches (2026-09-26)

Those last rewrites are the pass too: taken for a new line, the layout was held and sent to the model in place of the whole, and the whole was dropped
